notes.title: A Few Changes
notes.notes:
MAJOR
- THOMPSON now holds 50 rounds.
- The random box now shows a weapon before you swap.
- Added the ability to jump.

MINOR
- Added Nuclear calling card.
- Increased the THOMPSON damage from 15 to 16.
- Changed the THOMPSON ammo cap from 200 to 500.
- Fixed calling card not changing to selected card.
- Added UI to for weapon swapping.
- Added UI icons on calling card.
- Fixed clipping on some objects.
- Fixed stamina bug.
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't shoot.

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE #4
notes.notes:
We are getting closer to a new map being released!

Currently so far its just texturing and last bits of layout before we can ship it but anyways here are the patch notes;


 Added new sounds/impacts for surfaces.
 Fixed Animations for PPSH.
 Changed layout for Factory.
 Added sprint animations for multiplayer model.
 Added reload animations for multiplayer model.
 Added nametag to back of player model.
 Added new UI for seeing other players sprint and rads.

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE #3
notes.notes:
We have been working hard trying to get content out for L.S.S and we finally have something worth showing off.

L.S.S II now has 4 player coop!
It took sometime to get it working but it is now at a playable state, we also have done some noticeable changes to the game as well, so here are the patch notes.

CHANGES/ADDITIONS


4 Player coop!
2 New weapons (PPSH & .357 Magnum).
Buffed all weapons.
Shotgun now uses buckshot shells.
Added tracers.
Updated gfx for muzzle flashes.
Updated player model.
Added new UI.
Added new trap for FACTORY. (Cost: 1000 - Once per round).
Updated visuals on FACTORY.
New game over screen. 
Added custom crosshair.

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE #2 (22/10/19)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We have finally got some work done on L.S.S II and released an update, we hope you enjoy it!

LETS GET TO THE PATCH NOTES!

MAP

 Opened up the shutters to give a new way to escape/train.
 Added new places where Infected can get in from.


INFECTED

 Tweaked the "Brutes" rage speed from 5 to 4.2.
 Added new audio for all Infected.


PLAYER

 Added new UI.
 Added UI for keybinds.
 Added UI for Melee.


NETWORK

 Infected now move smoothly on the network for clients.
 Fixed Chat to work in game.
 Added map selection in lobby.


WEAPONS

 Added Axe melee upgrade.
 Added new grenades.


MISC

 Added 1 new achievement.
 Added UI for connecting to matchmaking.
 Added Steam Rich presence strings.
